answer.justification: All activation measurements are exactly zero: relative L2 is 0.000 at every reported layer, there is no onset layer, the final-layer jump is 0, cosine is 1.000, size ratio is 1.000 and the layer-2 spike is 0. That is the signature of the reference itself. Every tampered class shows non-zero internal differences. Quantization already differs by about 0.10 at layer 1 and both fine-tunes by about 0.09. Both system-prompt classes show a layer-2 spike of about 42. Output and logit levels were not measured, but they are not needed here: identical internal states produce identical outputs.
